# Data validation notes

## Giovanni request

Product: GPCP Monthly 0.5 Degree (GPCPMON), version 3.3; variable: sat_gauge_precip (mm/day).
Time range: December 1983 through February 2025; season: DJF, labelled by January year, years 1984-2025.
Request Giovanni area in west, south, east, north order: Indonesia 95E, 11S, 141E, 6N; Peru 82W, 10S, 76W, 3S. Select time series and download the result CSV from the results/download panel.
Expected match: equal-month mean of three monthly rates. Day-weighted series is included for sensitivity.

## Pass rule

Before comparison: maximum absolute difference for any season must be < 2% of the series mean, using the box mask and identical aggregation.

The current regional artifacts remain marked pending until the Giovanni CSVs are compared. Indonesia and coastal Peru are the only presets in the first Giovanni validation round.

## Featured preset proposals

Indonesia and coastal Peru are the first two presets. The following eight use the stated bounding boxes and are not individually checked: Amazon, Sahel, East Africa, India, Australia, California, Alberta / Prairies, and Southern Africa. Their artifacts carry a pending validation status and must be presented as same method, not individually checked.

## Mask diagnostics and box series

Cell fractions use geographic intersection; area weights are spherical cell area multiplied by the fraction (equivalent to cos(latitude) weighting on this grid).

## Featured presets

The preset catalog contains Indonesia and coastal Peru first, followed by the proposed Amazon, Sahel, East Africa, India, Australia, California, Alberta / Prairies, and Southern Africa box presets. The eight suggested boxes use box masks and remain marked pending / not individually checked. Only Indonesia and coastal Peru are in the first Giovanni comparison round. The Giovanni comparisons have not yet been supplied, so neither flagship result is marked passed.

## Global rainfall grid and timelapse

GPCP 0.5-degree cells are averaged into the 1-degree grid with cosine-of-latitude weights. Seasonal grid means are day-weighted and require every month of the season to be present. Tiles use the exact layout in `docs/GRID_FORMAT.md`; all 3,240 generated tiles are below 300 KB. The rainfall tile JSON totals 65,571,633 bytes, below the 150 MB variable limit.

The five global seasonal timelapses use a fixed 0–20 mm/day viridis scale per season and EPSG:4326 extent `[-180, -90, 180, 90]`. DJF contains 42 frames (1984–2025), totaling 594,919 PNG bytes, below the 15 MB limit. Other seasons contain 43 frames (1983–2025).

This branch does not contain `backend.trend.stats.sen_slope`. In accordance with the grid contract, per-cell Sen slopes are therefore stored as the int16 missing value, and the five trend-map PNGs have no slope data. Add the approved `sen_slope` implementation and rebuild the grid before presenting these trend maps as results.
